notes: All 11 fringe words were already present in existing activity_images or aac_extras — no new icons need to be sourced. The repetitive cumulative text 'Jump, Frog, Jump!' makes 'jump' the single most important fringe word and it should be visually prominent. The story follows a frog escaping a series of predators (fish, snake, turtle) and then humans with a net and basket — this sequence maps well to the fringe layout. 'escape' and 'swim' from aac_extras are useful supplementary words but were omitted from the 11 fringe slots in favour of concrete nouns that are more picturable and story-central; they remain available as extras. 'how' from aac_extras supports the book's repeated question structure and can be used conversationally alongside the core row.
